response.rationale: C1 uniquely integrates the adrenal mass (pheochromocytoma) with apical ballooning and normal coronaries (Takotsubo), explaining the full presentation. R3 explains the cardiac findings but ignores the adrenal mass; R5 explains the adrenal mass but not the cardiac findings.

rejected.why: Contradicted by normal coronary arteries; ST elevation and troponin are non-specific.
